description: Admin-only tool for managing MIND users and the Featured Minds Portal. Requires an admin API key. Full CRUD over featured minds (create / list / get_full / update / update_owner_profile / reorder / delete), plus user provisioning and tier/credit management. The Featured Minds Portal at /admin/featuredmindsportal uses these same endpoints — get_featured_mind_full + update_featured_mind_owner_profile let you edit the linked user's LLM model, public chat prompt, temperature, reasoning effort, brand fields, and avatar/banner from any MCP client.

action.description: Admin action. Featured Minds Portal actions: create_featured_mind, list_featured_minds, get_featured_mind_full (bundled view + owner profile + model catalog), update_featured_mind (catalog fields: title/description/tags/featured/display_order/is_public/avatar_url/banner_url/subtitle/price), update_featured_mind_owner_profile (write-through to linked user_profiles: preferred_llm_model, public_mind_prompt, chat_temperature, chat_reasoning_effort, public_mind_enabled, public_mind_tagline/greeting/persona, bio, avatar_url, banner_url), reorder_featured_minds (bulk display_order via ordered_mind_ids list), delete_featured_mind. User actions: create_user, list_users, update_user_tier, adjust_user_credits.

agent_posting_enabled.description: Influencer Factory: gate that lets autonomous agents post on this persona's behalf. Dark by default.

api_key_name.description: Name for the generated API key (defaults to '{source} integration')

archetype_id.description: Influencer Factory: archetype persona id (e.g. an Astra archetype template). Pass null to clear.

avatar_url.description: Avatar image URL (S3-hosted). Writes-through to user_profiles when used with update_featured_mind_owner_profile.

banner_url.description: Banner image URL (S3-hosted). Writes-through to user_profiles when used with update_featured_mind_owner_profile.

bio.description: Owner bio (shown across MIND profile surfaces, ≤500 chars)

chat_reasoning_effort.description: Per-MIND reasoning_effort override. Only honored for thinking-capable models (supports_reasoning_effort=true).

chat_temperature.description: Per-MIND temperature override (0.0–2.0). Null clears to provider default.

description.description: Long-form description shown on the public profile

display_order.description: Sort order in featured list (lower = earlier)

featured.description: Whether to show in the featured grid on /discover

generate_api_key.description: If true, also generate a developer API key (mind_...) for the new user

is_public.description: If true, anyone can query this mind at normal credit rate (marketplace public)

kg_scope_template_id.description: Influencer Factory: KG-scope template id that bounds what this persona knows/talks about. Pass null to clear.

mind_id.description: Featured mind ID — required for get_featured_mind_full / update_featured_mind / update_featured_mind_owner_profile / delete_featured_mind

niche_tags.description: Influencer Factory: niche/topic tags for this persona (e.g. ['fitness', 'wellness']). Separate from catalog `tags`.

ordered_mind_ids.description: For reorder_featured_minds: full list of mind_ids in the order you want. Index in the list becomes display_order.

preferred_llm_model.description: LLM model id (e.g. 'deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash', 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6'). Used by the public chat at /m/{username}. Pass null to clear and fall back to platform default. Use mind_admin with action=list_featured_minds then get_featured_mind_full to see available_models.

public_mind_enabled.description: Whether anonymous visitors can chat with this MIND at /m/{username}

public_mind_persona.description: Persona description used inside the auto-built default prompt (≤800 chars)

public_mind_prompt.description: System prompt used by the public chat (≤3000 chars). Empty string clears it and the auto-built default is used.

seed_image_url.description: Influencer Factory: anchor seed image URL (the reference photo every image-to-image variant pins to — do not chain). Pass null to clear.

source.description: Source app/partner that created this user (e.g. 'myapp')

subtitle.description: One-line hook shown under the title on portal cards (≤140 chars)

title.description: Display title for the featured mind

username.description: Username for new user (3-30 chars, letters/numbers/underscores)

voice_id.description: Influencer Factory: ElevenLabs voice id used by this persona. Pass null to clear.

name: mind_admin
